title: The advantage of discipline today
html:
“Nothing is more harmful to the service, than the neglect of discipline; for that discipline, more than numbers, gives one Army superiority over another.” – George Washington.

While George Washington is talking about the Army here, you can relate his quote to everyday life as well, and realise that discipline gives you a great advantage.
